name: Pimcore
description: Product information management and digital experience platform for managing catalog data across channels.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      PIMCORE_DB_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-mariadb"
      PIMCORE_DB_USER: pimcore
      PIMCORE_DB_NAME: pimcore
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/var:/var/www/html/var
      - {{appDataPath}}/public:/var/www/html/public
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: pimcore
      MYSQL_USER: pimcore
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
